headline: Sensex and Nifty slip as profit-taking hits IT stocks; L&T and Nuvama Wealth post gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit-taking emerged after recent market rallies, pushing indices below key psychological levels.
Major IT companies like TCS, Infosys, and HCL Tech are facing selling pressure, dragging the benchmarks.
Investors are reacting to mixed corporate news, including strong Q2 earnings and significant new contract wins.
Global market themes and economic data points like US nonfarm payrolls are keeping investor sentiment cautious.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 index is struggling to maintain the 25,000 level amid early trade volatility and profit-booking.
Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has secured a significant order from Noida Metro for the Aqua Line extension project.
Nuvama Wealth Management reported a 19% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 304 crore.
Dixon Technologies is facing cash flow challenges as surging receivables and inventory levels impact working capital.
summary: Indian indices opened flat but quickly slipped into the red as profit-booking hit the IT sector, with heavyweights like TCS and Infosys dragging the market. While L&T and Nuvama Wealth reported positive developments, Dixon Technologies faced scrutiny over cash flow concerns. Investors remain cautious following the Muhurat trading session, monitoring global cues and domestic earnings.
